what_it_does.name: stripe-best-practices
what_it_does.summary: Instructions and six reference documents for planning, building and reviewing Stripe integrations. A routing table sends each kind of integration, payments, Connect, billing, tax, Treasury or security, to a recommended API and a reference file, and critical rules set the latest API version 2026-10-28.endive, restricted API keys, dynamic payment methods and required webhooks. What comes out is advice and integration code, and with Stripe CLI or MCP access also checks run on the account, such as a test tax calculation. Use it when planning, building, modifying, testing or reviewing any Stripe integration.
tasks: choose between Checkout Sessions, PaymentIntents and Setup Intents
set up Connect platforms and marketplaces with Accounts v2
plan subscriptions and usage-based billing with Billing APIs and Metronome
set up Stripe Tax registrations and automatic_tax
secure API keys, webhooks, OAuth flows and Dashboard access
use separate sandboxes for development and testing
what_it_does.author_description: Guides Stripe integration decisions across development and test environment planning (separate sandboxes vs the shared test mode sandbox), API selection (Checkout Sessions vs PaymentIntents), Connect platform setup (Accounts v2, controller properties), billing/subscriptions, tax and registrations (Stripe Tax, automatic_tax, product tax codes), Treasury financial accounts, integration options (Checkout, Payment Element), migrating from deprecated Stripe APIs, and security best practices (API key management, API key permissions, webhooks, OAuth). Use when planning, building, modifying, testing, or reviewing any Stripe integration, including choosing a development environment, accepting payments, building marketplaces, integrating Stripe, processing payments, setting up subscriptions, collecting sales tax, VAT, or GST, creating connected accounts, or implementing secure key handling.

risks.risk: Stripe collects no tax while the user believes tax is on, when automatic_tax is enabled without an active registration.
risks.mitigation: confirm an active registration first, in the instructions

risks.risk: A Stripe API key committed to a source code repository can be taken over and seriously harm the user's business.
risks.mitigation: secrets vault, restricted keys, pre-commit hook and key rolling, in the instructions

risks.risk: Orders are silently dropped when fulfillment logic runs only on the success page and the customer never reaches it.
risks.mitigation: webhook handler for checkout.session.completed and checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, in the instructions

risks.risk: Platform operators bear financial liability for fraud and disputes on Express and Custom connected accounts.
risks.mitigation: Standard named as the safer default, in the instructions

risks.risk: Instructions read at run time from docs.stripe.com/.well-known/skills/metronome/SKILL.md steer the agent without being part of the files this card describes.
With execution access through MCP tools or a CLI token, the agent changes Tax Settings and runs calls on a live Stripe account.
risks.mitigation: user confirmation is required for registrations only, existing head office address and tax code are not to be overwritten

limitations: Stripe Tax does not process payments outside Stripe, automatically file every tax return, or support every jurisdiction.
Threshold monitoring only processes live-mode transactions and does not cover physical-presence obligations.
Threshold notifications are not real time and arrive within 1 or 2 days after a threshold is crossed.
The taxability_reason not_collecting cannot tell a missing registration from a Nontaxable product tax code.
Tax registrations and Tax Settings in a sandbox are scoped to that sandbox and do not appear in live mode.
Metronome does not support usage prices that must work with Connect, Adaptive Pricing or Workflows.

known_problems.workaround: check the product tax code, add a registration, then run a test transaction
set a head office address in Tax Settings first

known_problems.problem: enabling automatic_tax is rejected while manual tax_rates remain
known_problems.workaround: clear all tax_rates first, or use the Tax migration tool

known_problems.problem: 403 errors when testing a restricted API key
known_problems.workaround: add the missing permissions to the RAK

known_problems.problem: an API key is exposed or compromised
known_problems.workaround: roll the key immediately, check activity logs and contact Stripe support
